targets.review_note: Minimum-cost flow models original capacities at cost zero and extra capacity on existing pipes at unit cost. Successive shortest augmenting paths include reverse negative-cost arcs, allowing rerouting prior flow. Send full zero-cost bottlenecks, then only additional flow affordable under remaining budget. Never adds nonexistent pipes.

targets.review_note: BFS includes wait and four adjacent moves, tests car occupancy at arrival time because moves are simultaneous. Nearest starting lane moves right, alternating upwards. Traffic repeats every m turns, so visited state is cell and time modulo m. Earlier same phase dominates later arrivals; respect absolute round limit and non-wrapping frog.

targets.review_note: Determinize the nondeterministic movement process by the set of possible current rows or columns after each digit prefix. Appending a digit maps one subset to a unique opposite-axis subset, so DP counts digit strings once regardless of paths. Precompute nine transitions per subset, alternate horizontal/vertical steps 2N times, omit empty subsets.
